north.evidence: Mackay 1938 vol. II Plate XIII (PDF page 40 of the IGNCA 9954 scan), panel C 'MOHENJO-DARO DK. AREA (G. SECTION) (NORTHERN PORTION) PLAN OF LATE PERIOD (Ib & II) 1930-31': a short line through a circle with a cross, ending at the letter 'N'; the arrow points to the left of the page. No true or magnetic qualifier is printed. The panel title gives 1930-31 as the excavation season.

scale.note: Vertical scale bar of panel C, from the 0 tick to the 50 FEET end; 50 ft = 15.24 m
